authorization.scope: Versioned Minecart F1 successful-episode replay amendment, implementation, deterministic qualification, six paired local training and nominal-validation runs, evidence analysis, Git commit/push, and a new review PR.

conditional_actions.checkpoint-lock: Only after every A1R1 seed passes the frozen F1 retention gate and the source audit passes.
conditional_actions.final-test: Only after an explicit evidence-producing unlock gate following F1 qualification.
conditional_actions.paid-review: Requires a separate finite batch record within the existing cost limits; the earlier one-batch authorization is consumed.
conditional_actions.unattended-dispatch: Disabled until lifecycle and confinement hardening gates are verified.
